item.title: Multi-AZ Scaling for Everpure Cloud Azure Native Volumes on a VMSS
item.description: Are you running a scale set across availability zones and need every instance’s volume to live in the same zone as the instance? In Part 1 every instance got its own Everpure Cloud Azure Native volume on scale-out and cleaned it up on scale-in, but it all hung off a single storage pool in a single zone. This time I spread the scale set across two zones, gave each zone its own pool, and made sure an instance only ever attaches to the pool it shares a zone with.

item.title: Auto-Provisioning Everpure Cloud Azure Native Volumes for VMSS Scale Events
item.description: Are you scaling a VMSS workload that needs its own dedicated block volume per instance, one that shows up when the instance does and disappears when it’s gone? I went looking for the obvious way to wire that up on Everpure Cloud Azure Native and ran into a design that doesn’t actually exist in Azure, then built the one that does.
